description: This file defines the Menu controller class for the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It constructs a hierarchical menu of product categories with links and product counts, rendering a view with this data.

classes.name: Menu
classes.description: Controller class for generating the site menu based on categories and subcategories, tailored for the OpenCart platform.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Builds the categories and subcategories menu data, including product counts if configured, and renders the menu view.
